text:
Jade (recruiter): quick flag  candidate Omar (backend) has verbal offer request: start 2026-06-10, relocating from APAC. Manager asking for $5k sign-on + provisional uplift +3.8% to base, and benefits from day 1. Can we route exception?
Priya (people-ops): please paste one-line ask + business reason and ETA for relocation docs.
Jade (recruiter): Ask: $5k sign-on one-time; +3.8% provisional uplift; benefits effective on start date. Reason: competitor counter, mission-critical service owner, risk of losing offer. Candidate can send passport + address by 2026-06-03.
Ravi (hiring manager): Confirming business impact: we lose a 6-week roadmap if position stays open. Manager approves sign-on from discretionary.
Elaine (comp): +3.8% requires comp review sign-off (policy: <=3% auto, 3-7% comp review). Upload manager memo and budget owner approval please.
Nora (finance): Finance needs GL and headcount confirmation; sign-on ok from hiring budget if leader signs. GL=5020? please confirm.
Liam (onboarding): Notes: benefits enrollment feed needs 72h. For international starts we need right-to-work docs. If docs arrive after 2026-06-07 coverage may be delayed.
LegalBot: For day-1 benefits add clause: "Benefits eligibility begins on start date subject to carrier rules and timely verification of required documents." Legal will add template if approved.
Priya (people-ops): Routing: Manager -> Comp (Elaine) -> Finance (Nora) -> People Ops. Legal & Onboarding looped. Target decision by 2026-06-05 to meet 6/10 start.
Jade (recruiter): uploaded manager memo and budget approval. tagging @Elaine @Nora
Elaine (comp): reviewing memo now. If justification strong, I can sign-off +3.8% after Nora confirms run-rate.
Nora (finance): provisional ok pending headcount entry. GL confirmed 5020.
Priya (people-ops): checklist done except comp sign-off. Elaine please post final. Deadline EOD 2026-06-05.
Elaine (comp): signing off, leaving comment: provisional uplift approved. People Ops may finalize offer and include legal clause.
Jade (recruiter): thanks everyone :thumbsup: offer will go out today with day-1 clause and sign-on.
Liam (onboarding): queued benefits feed; will confirm when enrollment accepted.
